title: Whish Wallet
setupBody: Turn this on and "Whish" shows up as a way to pay at the till. Every Whish sale is saved here, so you can compare it with your Whish app.
setupNumberHint: The phone number customers send money to. The cashier sees it at checkout.
setupDone: Whish is on. It now shows at checkout.
setupAskOwner: Whish is not set up yet. Ask the owner or a manager to turn it on.
offNotice: Whish is turned off. New Whish sales are not saved here.
howTo: Every Whish sale lands here by itself. Open your Whish app, find each payment by its number, then tick the row.
noRowsBody: Whish sales show up here as soon as the cashier takes them.
dateHint: Leave as today unless it happened on an earlier day.
openingTip: First time? Record a "Correction" with the money already in your Whish account, so the balance matches.
name: Name
isActiveHint: Turn off to stop. The history stays.
